text:
Type: molded plastic tub armchair on pedestal
Use: casual sitting, lounging; living room, playroom, balcony
Style: retro, modern, contemporary
Materials: glossy molded plastic shell and base
Colors: bright white
Shape: rounded tub seat with low curved arms rising into the back, ribbed cylindrical body, wide round disc foot, compact and chunky
Feel: playful, clean, fun, sculptural
Goes with: bright colors, white walls, colorful cushions and rugs; retro, modern or playful rooms, kids' rooms
